seed_selection: This regression case deliberately reuses the staircase-v1, staircase-v2, and staircase-v3 seeds 1 through 10, in their original order and including reference seed 6, so the new survival and exit-discovery policy can be compared with the accepted milestone and prior policy trajectories. Earlier suite ids stay pinned to their own policies.
step_cap_rationale: The 1000-step cap and acceptance of 10 successes including seed 6 are fixed by milestone 2 item 10 and ADR 0005 regression criteria.
